hints: A change of a doctor is three writes: the doctor row, the old periods removed and the new ones inserted (`updateDoctor` in `server/src/repository.ts`). Which of them runs before the one the database refuses, and what stays when the last one fails?

The `CHECK` of `working_hours` refuses the insert of a period from 05:00. By then, the update of the doctor and the delete of the periods are already written. Each write is a statement of its own, so the failure of the third one undoes nothing.

Group the three writes in one transaction, so they are all kept or none is: `await db.transaction().execute(async (trx) => { ... })`, with every write inside using `trx` instead of `db`. `createDoctor`, right above, already does it this way.
